notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Wispweaver Angel spell.
Resolve the copy of the Wispweaver Angel spell.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Wispweaver Angel token.
Repeat from step 4.
